headline: Quarterly earnings per share fall sharply on the year
summary_short: Quarterly EPS was CNY 0.48 versus CNY 0.79 a year ago, down 39.4%, and down 2.0% from CNY 0.49 in the prior quarter.
summary_long: Earnings per share of CNY 0.48 compares with CNY 0.79 a year earlier and CNY 0.49 last quarter. These are the only verified figures on file. Search results conflicted on third-quarter revenue and profit, so no income-statement figures are reported and drivers are not assessed.
